A model of camouflage '''stormtrooper armor''' was used by the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
This armor closely resembled the [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by standard Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]]. However, instead of a clean [[Color/Legends|white]] appearance, the armor was patterned in a mottled greenish-brown hue, which allowed it to blend into the forest environments for which it was designed.<ref name="SWG:LD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Life Day}}</ref>

Another variant of this armor, called [[Imperial Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor]], also saw use by the Empire during the Galactic Civil War. This other version of armor more closely resembled the [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]].<ref name="SWG:IFCA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Imperial Forest Camouflage Armor}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a right bracer of this armor was found next to the skeletal remains of a stormtrooper on the balcony of a [[Mummer house|large house]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] overrun by [[Mummers]],<ref name="SWG:LISAC" /> a criminal organization of bootleggers.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> Other pieces of armor accompanied the corpse, including a helmet, chest plate and [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] belonging to a suit of standard white stormtrooper armor.<ref name="SWG:LISAC" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Sstrigge]], wore most of this suit of armor during [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] festivities in the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]], and [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]]. Sstrigge worked with the Empire to sabotage these Life Day festivities, as the Empire believed the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was using them as an opportunity to hide contraband in celebratory gift boxes.<ref name="SWG:LD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CamoOld.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The canceled full-body Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor]]
The Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LISAC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

This armor was originally revealed to be a reward for Imperial-aligned players of a revamped [[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] line. However, due to outcry from some players regarding its perceived lack of aesthetics, the developers chose not to release this suit of armor.<ref name="ROD">{{WebCite|url=http://www.swgalaxies.net/community/rodianrants/sept2507/index.htm|text=''Rodian Rants'': September 25, 2007|archivedate=20130325034809|nolive=1}}</ref> According to the game's directory tree files, the description of the armor read, "Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor. A recent development from Imperial Ordinance. Not routinely issued to troops."<ref name="TRE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> Eventually, with the release of [[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild]] on [[September 12]], [[2007]], a redesigned version of this armor was introduced as the reward for completing various quests of the revamped Imperial Theme Park. The new armor, fully known as [[W:c:swg:Imperial Forest Camouflage armour|Imperial Scout Trooper Forest Camouflage Armor]], more closely resembled [[W:c:swg:Scout Trooper armor|scout trooper armor]].<ref name="SWG:IFCA" />

Despite not being released on the live [[W:c:swg:Server|servers]] as a fully wearable form of player armor, the developers nonetheless incorporated elements of the Imperial Stormtrooper Forest Camouflage Armor in the game. With the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 11.4|Chapter 11.4: ''The Battle of Echo Base'']] on [[December 16]], [[2008]],<ref name="EchoBase">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=801676|text=Chapter 11.4: The Battle of Echo Base|nobackup=1}}</ref> a [[W:c:swg:Trandoshan|Trandoshan]] named Sstrigge could be seen wearing the armor's gloves, chest plate, leggings, and [[Belt/Legends|belt]] in the cities of [[W:c:swg:Dearic|Dearic]], [[W:c:swg:Doaba Guerfel|Doaba Guerfel]], and [[W:c:swg:Wayfar|Wayfar]] during the game's [[W:c:swg:Life Day|Life Day celebrations]]. Sstrigge could be found wearing these pieces of armor during subsequent Life Day events in [[2009]], [[2010]], and 2011.<ref name="SWG:LD" /> The right bracer of this armor could also be found on the balcony of a [[W:c:swg:Large Naboo House|large house]] on [[W:c:swg:Naboo|Naboo]] belonging to a group of [[W:c:swg:Mummers|Mummers]]. Curiously however, examining the bracer simply identified it as a "standard issue stormtrooper armor right bracer."<ref name="SWG:LISAC" />
